items.title: Quick hits: Aussie's dash to glory, Englishman drops his lollies
items.description: A broken lane rope holds up the swimming, an Australian wins gold after a mad dash from the medal podium, and an Englishman drops his lollies. Here are the quick hits from day one of the Commonwealth Games.

items.title: ICC dismisses prosecutor Karim Khan for serious misconduct
items.description: The International Criminal Court has dismissed prosecutor Karim Khan following an investigation into sexual misconduct allegations.

items.title: Coalition challenged by rise of One Nation in Victoria's east
items.description: Opposition Leader Jess Wilson has campaigned in Gippsland this week, hoping to lure back voters who are turning towards a surging One Nation.

items.title: A who's who of those at the centre of the ICAC's latest explosive probe
items.description: Eight weeks of public hearings by the corruption watchdog that could change the NSW Liberal Party forever begin on Monday. These are some of the key players embroiled in the donations investigation.

items.title: Iran's attacks on US bases in the Middle East mark 'end of an era'
items.description: Five months into a war Donald Trump said would last only weeks, the Iran conflict has so far cost the United States tens of billions of dollars and brought about "the end of an era" in American military strategy.

items.title: They drink our water and take our power, but do data centres create jobs?
items.description: Data centres are in development across Australia, but how many jobs will these big, thirsty facilities actually support?

items.title: Australia's 'monoculture' might be at the Labor conference
items.description: For those who believe in the virtue of converting and wrangling political trade-offs into a unified, coherent set of messages, Labor's example is transcendent.

items.title: Japan's popular princess sparks calls to ditch male-only succession law
items.description: There are only three people in line to inherit Japan's Chrysanthemum Throne, and one of them is 90 years old. All three of them are men.

items.title: India's 'unserious' gen Z protesting with grit and humour
items.description: Across the country's protest hotspots, India's gen Z are using meme culture as part of their hopes to bring the country into a new dawn.

items.title: 'If you get cancer, you will go bankrupt': Anna Funder on life in the US
items.description: The award-winning author, who burst onto the literary scene with her debut, Stasiland, in 2003, discusses writing, AI and the rise of fascism.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
